loot_policy: Members-style ordinary main tables for all players, no Ring of Wealth, surface Nature talisman and pre-Legends quest policy. Conditional/tertiary drops deferred. Monkey bones use pre-Tai Bwo Wannai Trio state. Crocodile is the land variant only.

families.name: Birds
families.model_note: Native kaliri/owl for jungle birds and ducks; carrion bird for seagulls/vultures; stock chicken.

families.name: Crabs
families.model_note: Darkshore crawler displays 641/1000/1001, active melee forms only.

families.name: Crocodiles
families.model_note: Classic Dreadmaw crocolisk display 1250; land form.

families.name: Dogs
families.model_note: Scarlet Tracking Hound hyena display 2709; neutral wild dogs and hostile guards/jackals.

families.name: Monkeys
families.model_note: Scaled-down Stranglethorn gorilla displays 843/837 as approved ape stand-in.

families.name: Snakes
